name: NX Recall
tagline: Local conversation memory with speaker recognition and offline voice

artifacts.label: Daemon + desktop app (Linux)
artifacts.postInstallNote: Prepare speech models with `~/.local/bin/recalld models fetch`, then start recording with `systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user enable --now nx-recall`. Choose permitted applications and microphones in Sources; capture is opt-in. Optional semantic search and memory summaries have separate model downloads. Lanalu has her own tab: Set up Local Voice downloads about 3 GB plus Python packages (allow 4 GB free), then choose Virtual in/out or local audio. Shared recognition requires Recall to capture the same input; separate recognition is also available. Inference is local and needs no paid API. Installation, model setup and updates use the network. Data and models under ~/.local/share/nx-recall survive updates and uninstall.
